routing.method: Unchanged mirrored PCells and M1 escapes. Disjoint paired M3 buses share identical heights. Full-span output buses have equal length, mirrored M2 extent, and three physically grounded M3 shields connected by symmetric M4 spines. Output series-path differences and the common tail's off-center drain escape remain explicitly measurable; no perfect-symmetry claim.

ground_shields.connection: Two real M4 spines join all three M3 shields to the existing VSS M3 bus through eight actual open_pdks via3 cells.

output_balancing.limitation: Attached qp M2 stubs match mirrored metal extent, not series resistance. Report series paths and stubs separately; output M3 tracks remain at different heights.
